# Idea to production (complete spine with build, test, release and post-launch review) — stages

<!-- Generated by scripts/package/render_roles.py from workflow.yaml. -->

One orchestrator takes an idea or an existing product through research, executive review, product definition, brand, research-first design, architecture, build in vertical slices, security review, testing, documentation, release readiness, production release with human approval, and a dated post-launch review. Every stage has an owner, an output, an anti-slop self-check, and an independent review or human approval before the next stage starts.

**Trigger:** A user wants something taken all the way from idea or existing product to a running, released product, and wants one accountable orchestrator.
